propositions: The ast.Attribute branch in _wrapper_name that matches attribute-form git wrapper calls has existed since commit 6739ea54fa but lacks test coverage, leaving the behavior undocumented and vulnerable to future refactors.

All eight existing R2 tests in test_raw_git_write_lint.py exercise only bare ast.Name form (e.g., _git(...)), never attribute form (e.g., core._git(...)), making the attribute-form detection untested despite working correctly.

The gate correctly resolves push_lease_cas in _ref_lock_push.py and does not fire because 'push' is not in MUTATION_VERBS, so no marker is warranted and this behavior must be explicitly pinned to avoid reinterpretation as a blind spot.

Four new tests must pin attribute-form detection: mutation verb firing, receiver-shape independence, opaque argv fail-closed behavior, and marker silencing on the attribute form, to prevent deletion of the ast.Attribute branch when all existing tests remain green.
